children: Vertex Pharmaceuticals is appointing a new chief financial officer in connection with the biotechnology company's $10 billion acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals.
Vertex on Tuesday said Jonathan Poole, currently senior vice president of finance, will become executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective Jan. 1, 2027.

The Boston company said it has completed the acquisition of Crinetics and that Charles Wagner, currently executive vice president and chief operating and financial officer, is taking on an expanded role overseeing the integration. Wagner will continue as chief operating officer.

Vertex also said it has hired Jasper van Grunsven as executive vice president and chief pain and new product planning officer, effective Sept. 8. Van Grunsven most recently served as senior vice president of Amgen's rare disease portfolio and global customer capabilities data and analytics function.
